settings.heading: Why Heelguard.
settings.lede: Linear drains mostly differ at the grate. Here is what this pattern changes, and how it is built.

settings.title: Heel friendly
settings.body: The wedge wire and tapered cross bars give a more comfortable, practical grate surface underfoot than an open grid.

settings.image_alt: A bare foot resting flat on the Heelguard grate, showing the heel-friendly wedge-wire surface

settings.title: Pet friendly
settings.body: Suitable for bathrooms and laundries where pets use the space alongside you.

settings.title: Built for water flow
settings.body: The drainage base is formed to direct water toward the outlet, and the cross bars are positioned to maintain flow through the grate.

settings.title: Easy to clean
settings.body: The grate lifts out, giving direct access to the internal channel for removing hair and debris.

settings.title: 304 stainless steel
settings.body: A premium, durable material choice for internal wet areas, with a brushed finish that suits contemporary tapware.

settings.image_alt: Macro detail of the Heelguard wedge-wire grate showing the 3mm wire, 4mm aperture and perimeter edge bar

settings.title: Designed for installation
settings.body: Profiles, outlet positions and documentation are shaped by real bathroom installation requirements — not retrofitted to them.

settings.title: Specified up front
settings.body: Widths, depths, apertures and outlet diameters are published so you can check the drain against your build before ordering.

settings.label: Construction
settings.heading: Built like a drain. Designed like architectural hardware.

settings.title: 304 stainless steel
settings.body: The drain is made from 304 stainless steel and is intended for internal applications — showers, bathrooms and laundries.

settings.title: Wedge wire Heelguard grate
settings.body: The Heelguard grate is built from 3mm wedge wire at a 4mm aperture, with welded cross braces and a full perimeter edge bar.
settings.specs: 3mm wedge wire, 4mm aperture, Welded cross braces

settings.title: Perimeter edge bar
settings.body: A 5mm × 20mm deep edge bar runs the full perimeter of the grate, eliminating sharp edges where the grate meets the tile.

settings.title: Cross bracing
settings.body: Cross bars sit at approximately 25mm centres. They hold the wedge wire true and are positioned to maintain water flow through the grate.

settings.title: Tapered cross bars
settings.body: The cross bars are tapered rather than square. The taper is designed to reduce the build-up of dirt and grime inside the grate.

settings.title: Fully welded construction
settings.body: The body is fully welded rather than folded and sealed, and the drainage base is formed to direct water toward the outlet.
